value.description: Daniel's family member who is mentioned as not influencing the speaker and as having held the family together.
evidence: Rosa does not know I have done this.
Hijo, you did not hold us together. Rosa did.
Rosa will not put you out

value.description: Daniel's sister who is mentioned as not influencing the speaker and as receiving a share of the house.
evidence: his sister has been working on me
Lucia does not know I have done this.
Your sister did, in her way, from far away
Lucia — you have wanted to come home for a long time
The house is yours, in thirds

value.description: The speaker's son who is addressed with affection and whose claim to the house is rejected.
evidence: I know what my son will say.
Daniel — mi hijo, mi primero — I love you.
You have wanted this house since you were sixteen years old.
You wanted it then because you thought it would make you the head of something.
your brother, if he is the man I believe he can still become

value.description: The family house whose ownership and meaning are being decided in the speaker's declaration.
evidence: You have wanted this house since you were sixteen years old.
